title: La crisis de 1982
goal: Read how the US Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes under Volcker made Latin American debt suddenly unpayable, and how Mexico's August 1982 default announcement triggered a region-wide domino effect.

items: Explain what the Fed did under Volcker starting in 1979.
Explain why this hit variable-rate debt so hard.
State what Silva Herzog announced on August 12, 1982.
Describe the domino effect across the region.
Use de un día para otro to stress a sudden change.
